name: FlowGPT
tagline: FlowGPT is a community platform for sharing, discovering, and running AI prompts and workflow templates across popular models like ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini. Users browse a library of prompts organized by category, run them directly in the platform, and publish their own for others to use and remix. It serves as both a prompt repository and a lightweight way to try AI workflows without writing prompts from scratch.
